questions.question: What is the process of applying a thin layer of zinc metal on iron articles to protect them from rusting called?

options.explanation: Electroplating is a process of depositing a thin layer of a material, usually a metal, onto the surface of another material using an electric current.

Galvanization is a specific method of corrosion prevention where iron is coated with a layer of zinc. Zinc is more reactive than iron, providing both a physical barrier and sacrificial protection.
Alloying is the process of mixing two or more elements, at least one of which is a metal, to produce a material with desirable properties.
